; PROBE (temporary): does xochitl's Qt decode fastshot's top-down 32bpp BI_RGB BMP?
; Loads /tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp into an invisible Image and logs status + size.
; Deployed manually, removed after reading the journal.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: bmpDecodeProbe
				visible: false

				Image {
					id: bmpProbeImage
					visible: false
					cache: false
					onStatusChanged: {
						console.log("BMPPROBE status=" + status
							+ " (1=Ready 2=Loading 3=Error)"
							+ " size=" + sourceSize.width + "x" + sourceSize.height);
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 4000
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						console.log("BMPPROBE setting source");
						bmpProbeImage.source = "file:///tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp";
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
